<x_0.0361><y_0.0375>Back Propagation Training Algorithm 22<x_0.9619><y_0.4625><class_Picture>

<x_0.0518><y_0.468>[1] Initialize all Weights with random values<x_0.3945><y_0.5078><class_Text>

<x_0.0527><y_0.507>[2] Provide one training sample at a time (and its corresponding target label)<x_0.6367><y_0.5477><class_Text>

<x_0.0508><y_0.5703>[3] Go Forward : Start from Input Layer, Calculate Netj, Oj for each layer till reach output layer<x_0.8828><y_0.6234><class_Text>

<x_0.0498><y_0.6328>[4] Go Backward : Start from Output Layer, Calculate Δji, Wji for each weights of **Output** layer
Δjj = η Oi Oj(1−Oj) (tj−Oj) **Store:** δj = Oj(1−Oj) (tj−Oj) _(for each node at output Layer)_<x_0.9111><y_0.7266><class_Text>

<x_0.0488><y_0.7461>[5] Go Backward : go to previous Layer, Calculate Δji, Wji for each weights of **Hidden** layer
Δjj = η Oi Oj(1−Oj) [ ∑ k (δk wkj)] **Store:** δj = Oj(1−Oj) [ ∑ k (δkwkj)] _(for each node at hidden Layer)_<x_0.958><y_0.8602><class_Text>

<x_0.0469><y_0.882>[6] Repeat [5] till reach first hidden layer<x_0.4092><y_0.9297><class_Text>

<x_0.1104><y_0.9305>Remember: δk = δjof next layer ( which is already calculated in previous step )<x_0.7168><y_0.975><class_Text>
